title: A composite of etale coverings is an etale covering
statement: Let $T$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Let $(f_i:T_i\to T)_{i\in I}$ be a family of etale morphisms [def-weil-etale-morphism] which is jointly surjective ($T=\bigcup_i f_i(T_i)$), and for every $i\in I$ let $(g_{ij}:T_{ij}\to T_i)_{j\in J_i}$ be a jointly surjective family of etale morphisms. Then the family $(f_i\circ g_{ij}:T_{ij}\to T)_{i\in I,\,j\in J_i}$ consists of etale morphisms and is jointly surjective. In particular, a composite of two surjective etale morphisms is surjective and etale.

source.place: Lemma 0217 (lemma-etale), part (2); used in Hypercoverings, Lemma 01GH (lemma-funny-gamma), proof, last sentence 'a composition of coverings is a covering'
